summary: Unexpected surplus credit (negative invoice) after hourly consolidation for multitenant seat billing
description: Issue summary: BrightDocs reported that their finalized invoice for 2026-02-28 shows a net negative payable (surplus credit) of $1,218.30 after hourly consolidation. Impact: Customer billing shows credit beyond what was expected, autopay attempted and then failed because final invoice reflected negative total and payment gateway rejected the autopay flag. Environment: Dedicated tenant on us-west. Customer uses seat-based metering overlay (per-seat seat-hour) plus reserved GPU capacity credits and a separate KV-cache warmup credit stream. Observed behavior: During the hourly consolidation run the reconciler applied a second set of provisional credits for the same subaccount usage window, resulting in an over-credit and a negative invoice line. Expected behavior: Deduplicated postbacks and smoothing algorithm should allocate exactly one set of provisional credits per hour window, not double-apply on merged subaccount overlays. Additional context: BrightDocs recently performed an org merge of two subaccounts and enabled a seat-split feature; that merge coincides with the hourly-run when the anomaly occurred. Customer reached out via support@brightdocs.com and posted in #support-billing Slack thread (linked below).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In prod, create two subaccounts under one parent org mirroring BrightDocs org IDs (org: bd-981, sub: bd-981-a, bd-981-b).
2) Send hourly postbacks for the same hour window from both sub accounts (postback payload includes reserved_hours, kv_warmup_credit, seat_hours).
3) Trigger the hourly-consolidation job (POST /internal/billing/reconcile/hourly?window=2026-02-28T00:00Z) with reconciliation flag force=true.
4) Observe billing service applying provisional credits and the duplicate allocation when both subaccount tags map to the consolidated billing namespace.
5) Finalize invoice-run via /billing/invoices/finalize and check resulting invoice lines.

investigation_notes: 2026-03-01: Initial triage by CS (Aisha). Confirmed customer-visible negative invoice and autopay failure. Requested logs and invoice PDF from billing team.

2026-03-02: SRE (Diego) reproduced duplicate provisional credits locally by forcing consolidation with merged subaccount mapping. Reproduction exact when seat-hour keys normalized to consolidated namespace but dedup key used subaccount-scoped identifier.

2026-03-03: Hypothesis: dedupe key generation used 'subaccount_id + metric' rather than 'consolidated_namespace + metric', so when org merge mapping returned two subaccount identifiers that canonicalized to same consolidated namespace after mapping stage, dedupe check ran earlier and missed collision.

2026-03-04: Investigated reconciler commit history; found a recent refactor (PR 211) that moved dedupe check after mapping step — regression introduced order-of-operations bug. Related PR listed in related_github_prs.
2026-03-05: Cross-checked the postback stream — there were no duplicate retries; both postbacks were valid distinct subaccount events that should have been collapsed by consolidator.
comments: Aisha Patel (2026-03-01): Customer BrightDocs reports negative final invoice; they have autopay scheduled for 2026-03-02 and want hold on autopay until resolved. Attached invoice PDF and screenshots.

Diego Morales (2026-03-02): Reproduced locally. Suspect dedupe ordering regression introduced in postback-reconciler refactor (see PR 211). I will create a patch to perform dedupe after namespace mapping.
Billing Ops (2026-03-03): Temporarily marking invoice inv_20260228_bd981 as 'manual-review' to stop autopay. Notifying payments to skip charge.
Aisha Patel (2026-03-04): Customer accepts manual hold; requests credit memo and corrected invoice. Asked for ETA on fix and whether other customers impacted.

Diego Morales (2026-03-05): Running a full-scan across orgs with recent merges to enumerate exposure; preliminary scan shows 6 orgs with similar mapping overlap windows in last 7 days. Will coordinate hotfix and follow-up reconciliation run.
resolution: Workaround: Billing Ops put affected invoice inv_20260228_bd981 in manual-review and set autopay=false; payments notified to skip charging BrightDocs. We issued provisional credit memo CP-20260301 to offset customer-facing negative total until reconciliation completes. Permanent fix: patch in postback-reconciler to compute dedupe keys using consolidated_namespace+metric after mapping stage, deploy hotfix v1.2.3 to staging (PR 217) and run test consolidation on snapshot of affected windows. Post-deploy actions: run backfill reconciliation for windows 2026-02-26 through 2026-03-02, re-generate corrected invoices (inv_corr_20260228_bd981), and issue final credit memo/adjustment. Follow-up items: add unit test coverage for merge/namespace mapping edgecases, add monitoring alert on negative-finalized-invoice events, and schedule a postmortem in Confluence (link in related_confluence_pages). Estimated ETA for code fix and reconciliation: 2026-03-11.
